The three climate-data curves in the figure respectively represent the July average temperature, January average temperature, and annual precipitation; near ③, the July average temperature and January average temperature are relatively high, and the annual precipitation is also in a relatively high position, showing warmer and wetter characteristics than some suburbs. The question stem emphasizes that the “industrial layout is reasonable,” so the industrial area should not be located in the city’s main upwind direction, so as to avoid pollutants being blown toward the urban area, but should be laid out in the crosswind direction of the prevailing wind or in the direction of the minimum wind frequency. If the industrial area is located on the southeast side of the urban area and the layout is reasonable, then the city’s dominant wind direction should be roughly northeast–southwest, making the southeast side a relatively crosswind position. The region in China that has a northeast–southwest monsoon wind-direction combination and conforms to this industrial-layout judgment is Southwest China.

method.method_draft: 先从图中确认③在城区东南侧且温度、降水偏高，判断该处可能是工业活动较强的郊区。再利用题干“工业布局合理”，把东南侧工业区与城市盛行风关系联系起来：合理布局说明该工业区不应位于主要上风向，而应在侧风向或最小风频方向。与东南侧布局相匹配的是主导风向大致为东北—西南向的地区。我国具有这种季风风向组合并符合题意的是西南地区。

该推理 trace 整体通过。它先描述图像、再进行气候区位推理，顺序符合图像题要求；最终答案“西南地区”与标准答案一致，也基本遵循了方法草稿。图像中的横轴 NW-SE、城区与郊区点位、7月均温二十多摄氏度、1月均温高于0℃、年降水量接近1000毫米等关键信息均能从图中读出。唯一可微调之处是年降水量数值范围表述“960毫米到975毫米附近”略偏低，图中部分点接近或略高于975毫米，可改为“大致960多到980毫米左右，接近1000毫米”以更贴合图像。

Read the figure and answer: <image1> If the industrial layout of this city is reasonable, then in which region of China is this city most likely located?
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, a direction axis from left to right represents NW to SE; the urban area is located in the middle of the section, ①② are on the northwest side of the urban area, and ③④ are on the southeast side of the urban area, among which ③ is immediately adjacent to the southeast side of the urban area. The three climate-data curves in the figure respectively represent the July average temperature, January average temperature, and annual precipitation; near ③, the July average temperature and January average temperature are relatively high, and the annual precipitation is also in a relatively high position, showing warmer and wetter characteristics than some suburbs.

Reasoning: ③ is on the southeast side of the urban area and has relatively high temperature and precipitation, so it can be judged that this place may be affected by relatively strong human activities or industrial activities. The question stem emphasizes that the “industrial layout is reasonable,” so the industrial area should not be located in the city’s main upwind direction, so as to avoid pollutants being blown toward the urban area, but should be laid out in the crosswind direction of the prevailing wind or in the direction of the minimum wind frequency. If the industrial area is located on the southeast side of the urban area and the layout is reasonable, then the city’s dominant wind direction should be roughly northeast–southwest, making the southeast side a relatively crosswind position. The region in China that has a northeast–southwest monsoon wind-direction combination and conforms to this industrial-layout judgment is Southwest China.
